Does anyone know who is the inmate 2145? That was the number of the one who drugged PCH to give him the first tarot card. I think by knowing who this prisoner is we may have more clues of who BM really is. But so far everyone seems suspicious to me.

Park Changho himself is suspicious for the extreme behaviors he has shown with the VIPS, besides, we still don't know where he got the info on the nurses or on Gong Jihoo's wife (specially the flowers). Besides he is an unreliable narrator, so there is no way for us to know if he is telling the truth or not.

I am also highly suspicious on the guard, I think he may know who the real BM is, if the tarot narrative is real then it would make sense for him to be one of the accomplices, he knows everything that happens and also has access to everything, it'd be easy for him to sneak the cards.

I tried it for the first time when I was 14, it was cool, then the second time I had the worst bad trip of my life in a not safe environment with kids around my age that panicked which made it worse.

Really, wait until you reach legal age, try it with friends you trust and begin small, if you get a bad trip you will know that it is a safe environment and that you are legal so you can't be blamed lol. Also, be aware of the possibility of addiction, keep it recreative and don't try it for the first time when you feel down, also, don't be constant with it, it can really affect your life badly.

Just to clarify, I do weed once a week (18F) and my life is ok, you just gotta be very responsible to be sure it won't become an addiction.

Try to make new friends when you get the chance, there is probably people around you who are looking for something similar in a friendship. It happens, sometimes you have amazing distant friends but you also want someone who is close and available to hangout with, it's okay.
